title: Castle Rushen
geometryBasis: Native mapped castle wall, inner keep and keep courtyard, gatehouse buildings and outlying bastion, original elevation and the exact public-domain Qualla harbour photo.
sectionBasis: The tallest tower reaches 24 metres. Four lower and upper crenellated masses surround the inner court, with the harbour-facing gatehouse and curtain stepping down to the quay.
limitations: The model represents the limestone keep, enclosed court, curtain wall and gate buildings seen in 2005. The modern visitor layout and interiors are outside the scope.
The highest tower uses the published 24 m height. Relative tower tiers, crenel counts, lower gate details and wall heights away from the harbour photo are estimates.
